title: A couple of odd issues since the August 3rd Release. The job text is now fixed. Smoothed heart rate line is broken.
symptom: Since the August 3rd release of xDrip+, the IoB text at the top of the main screen is flaky or missing, and the smoothed heart rate graph line is broken and discontinuous. The steps graphics are also smaller. These issues are present in nightly releases after August 3rd but not in the August 3rd release itself.
cause: The IoB issue was a bug introduced in releases after August 3rd, fixed in the Dec 9th Nightly. The heart rate graph issue is related to the 'smooth heart rate graph' option being checked.
fix: For the IoB issue, update to the Dec 9th Nightly (2022.12.09) or later. For the heart rate graph issue, uncheck the 'smooth heart rate graph' option in the Smartwatch Sensors settings, or wait for a future fix.
evidence_quote: It looks like the heart rate graph issue is related to the "smooth heart rate graph" option being checked. Unchecking that option clears the issue up but creates a very jagged heartbeat line.
